Settings
Controls & Keybindings

Click any binding button and press a new key. Sprint with Ctrl or double-tap W (hold Sprint in water to Sprint-Swim). Mouse: Left-Click Mine/Attack (wait for crosshair cooldown for full cleave!), Hold Right-Click to Draw Bow / Eat / Block with Shield / Zoom Spyglass / Channel Hearthstone. Press F to quick-place a Torch, V to Dodge-Dash, Space in mid-air with Sky Glider to Glide, M for World Map, B to pin a Waypoint, J for Survival Journal, L for Advancements, F5 for Third-Person Camera, F1 to hide HUD, F3 for Debug. Tame Wolves with Bones! Right-click a Smithing Bench to Repair, Upgrade to Netherite, or Disenchant gear.
